No DNS classes in the jnetpcap, pkts, Ardikars pcap, jxpacket or jxnet jars; io.vproxy:pcap4j-core is a fork of the selected Pcap4J; nl.sidnlabs:pcap-lib decodes DNS through the selected SIDN dnslib; pcap-to-athena is a Spring Boot application; Kaitai Struct publishes only its runtime and compiler, no compiled DNS format artifact.

Clojure DNS libraries (clj-dns, clj-dnsjava, protocol53, rfc1035-clojure and others) wrap dnsjava, manage provider records or are unpublished; Clojars artifacts have no deps.dev metric. The Groovy hits are Jenkins, Grails and plugin projects with no DNS message parser.

round7_discovery.note: Round-7 discovery with routes not used in rounds 1-6: deps.dev reverse dependencies of every selected path (and its other Scala/Maven coordinates), read from the deps.dev web dependents endpoint (https://deps.dev/_/s/maven/p/<package>/v/<version>/dependents, one call per release; directSample lists the direct dependents and its sizes add up to the summed directCount for all but netty-codec-dns, 1,030 of 1,038); more Maven Central Solr searches, including packaging filters for Kotlin Multiplatform artifacts (p:klib, p:module); JVM network-protocol frameworks and packet libraries with a DNS packet model (vproxy, ONOS onlab-misc, Netty's netty-all aggregator); and GitHub repository searches for Kotlin Multiplatform, Kotlin and Scala DNS message or packet libraries. Hits are leads; every candidate taken further is ranked only by deps.dev direct dependents summed over releases (round7_targeted).

deps_dev_reverse_dependents.result: None of the 587 sampled dependents is a separate DNS message parser. Names matching DNS or protocol terms are wrappers, resolvers, servers or applications over the selected parser they depend on: dnsjava wrappers (ph-dns, spotify dns, camel-dns, james dnsservice, smack resolver, dnssecjava, mdnsjava, tuweni-dns-discovery, net.rpcnet.securitytoolkit:dns, org.kendar.protocol:protocol-dns-plugin, java-dns-server, nacos-dns and others), dns4s-akka/-fs2/-netty transport modules over dns4s-core, minidns client/dnssec/resolver modules over minidns-core, Netty-based servers and clients (eureka-dns-server, servicetalk-dns-discovery-netty, mockserver-netty), nl.sidnlabs:pcap-lib over dnslib (round 6), and Pcap4J packet factories, samples and capture tools (PLC4X drivers, jxpacket-pcap4j, fs2-pcap).

other_routes.route: JVM network-protocol frameworks and packet libraries with their own DNS packet model
other_routes.note: vproxy's public Formatter.parsePackets decodes only the types listed in its DNSType enum (A, CNAME, PTR, TXT, AAAA, SRV, OPT and query-only types): MX (15) becomes DNSType.OTHER without its number and RData.newRData returns null for it, so the response control cannot be reported (source inspection of the 1.0.0-BETA-12 sources jar). The ONOS onlab-misc packet library has no DNS classes (jar listing). netty-all aggregates the selected netty-codec-dns. androidpoet dns is a DoH/DoT resolver whose JVM jar bridges to a native library through JNI (internal DnsBridge); it has no public message decoder.
